description: x402-polyperp-trades: The recent trade tape for one Polymarket Perps market — every fill with its side, price, size and timestamp — plus the derived flow statistics a signal actually uses: buy/sell volume split, net flow, volume-weighted average price, the largest print, and average trade size. Works for equities, indices and commodities as well as crypto. Use x402-polyperp-book to see resting liquidity, and this to see what actually executed.
name: x402-polyperp-trades
